component.name: PyNextCloud Sync
component.summary: Lightweight Nextcloud file synchronization for Linux

description.p: PyNextCloud Sync keeps one complete physical local mirror of a Nextcloud account synchronized through the official nextcloudcmd engine.
It adds GNOME integration, filesystem monitoring, server push notifications, safety intervals, secure account setup, exclusions, and logs.

ul.li: Relicensed PyNextCloud Sync under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later.
About now identifies and displays GPLv3 through GTK's native license presentation.
Updated project, Debian, AppStream, documentation, terms, and translation metadata for the new license.
Recovered explicitly from inotify queue overflow by rebuilding monitoring and requesting a protected nextcloudcmd reconciliation.
Recorded a minimal durable marker around nextcloudcmd so interrupted wrapper runs remain visible until a new safety baseline is committed.
Kept synchronization semantics inside nextcloudcmd; the desktop wrapper adds no custom reconciliation engine.
Fixed automatic update notices opening on another monitor at the desktop origin during normal application startup.
Update notices now wait for the main window to map before being created with the correct transient relationship.
Mandatory updates now show only Download New Version and Close Application.
Kept update notices above the main window and re-presented them after launcher activations.
Moved update actions above the scrollable release details and linked downloads directly to the latest release.
Added a more urgent mandatory-update presentation with an unavailable Not Now action and a separate application exit.
Added automatic update checks through a validated version manifest hosted in the GitHub repository.
Added non-blocking optional update notices and mandatory blocking before synchronization runtime initialization.
Added a manual update check in About, semantic version comparison, safe failure handling, UTC release dates, and an expandable full changelog.
Added a protected first synchronization that uses a fresh isolated server snapshot before enabling bidirectional synchronization.
Added an explicit analysis and merge review for empty, populated, conflicting, and previously synchronized local folders.
Added a persistent safety baseline that blocks missing, replaced, emptied, unreadable, or abnormally reduced local trees before nextcloudcmd starts.
Added safe recovery, one-time deletion approval, preserved conflict copies, and configurable deletion review thresholds.
Fixed credential lookup after biometric GNOME login by explicitly unlocking the default password collection before searching it.
Prevented a locked Login collection from being misreported as a missing Nextcloud credential during desktop autostart.
Added diagnostics and a regression test matching the observed GNOME Keyring startup behavior.
Fixed Debian upgrade detection by querying the live D-Bus owner instead of treating list-apps as a process list.
Upgrades now confirm the old instance has exited before replacing files and restart only previously active sessions.
Replaced the inaccurate package-upgrade fixture with a regression test matching the real GLib behavior.
Fixed running-instance discovery during Debian upgrades without relying on SUDO_UID.
Upgrades now stop and restart the application through each active per-user D-Bus session.
Added an executable regression test for graceful package-upgrade shutdown and restart.
Added the native GNOME Keyring unlock prompt needed after biometric desktop login.
Kept canceled unlocks separate from invalid Nextcloud credentials and prevented repeated automatic prompts.
Resumed file synchronization and notify_push together after an explicit successful unlock.
Made interactive Debian upgrades gracefully stop and restart a running application.
Published corrected project, issue, and changelog links under the canonical ehstbr repository.
Bumped the package version so systems with 0.1.8 installed apply the corrected metadata and application files.
Added native Files sidebar and desktop shortcuts for the synchronized folder.
Added a branded folder icon and independent settings for the three integrations.
Files bookmark changes now remain consistent with the Settings window.
Settings now opens as an independent window directly from the tray.
The main window remains closed and unallocated when opening Settings.
Fixed opening Settings from the tray while the main window is closed.
Made the main interface lazy and releasable to reduce background memory.
Bounded command output, log display, activity history, and login polling.
Avoided unnecessary inotify and push reconfiguration.
Added click-to-expand activity messages and right-click copy support.
Bundled translations and fixed Brazilian Portuguese locale detection.
Completed the Brazilian Portuguese application catalog.
Made the tray icon, title, tooltip, and attention state follow synchronization state changes live.
Added compatible StatusNotifierItem and D-Bus property change notifications.
Fixed the branded tray icon on GNOME AppIndicator hosts.
Added correct icon theme metadata, an absolute SVG path, and pixel fallbacks.
Responsive compact main window and collapsible activity view.
Reliable tray menu with a branded icon fallback.
Configurable daily log files and expanded About information.
Fixes for D-Bus menu variants, literal log text, and numeric formatting.
